parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kettle, typically made of stainless steel. It is circular and fits snugly on top of the kettle body.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the kettle to retain heat and prevent water from spilling or evaporating too quickly.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the kettle, made of heat-resistant plastic to allow safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and pour the kettle safely without direct contact with the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kettle, made of stainless steel, forming the container for holding water.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and heats the water, transferring heat efficiently from the heat source to the liquid inside.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main structural component of the kettle.
